What We Do

Autonomous Deal Execution

Autonomous Deal Execution

AI tools summarize and enter data to your CRM, but it’s still up to your reps and managers to humanly decide how to forecast, progress and win each deal.


Spotlight.ai decides, acts and progresses deals by driving critical sales activities for your team so your team can focus on what they excel in – human interactions.


Spotlight.ai qualifies and inspects the entire pipeline like your best team members.


Full traceability from the big picture down to the true status of every deal with its risks and opportunities, based on customer calls, emails, slack and face to face meetings.
